long_biography.plain_text:
At Astra Merck, Matthew William Emmens helped build a stand-alone drug company around cross-functional teams, giving research, manufacturing and commercial staff a shared voice. The joint venture marketed Prilosec, then the world's bestselling medicine, and Emmens later became its chief executive. He carried that commercial focus to Shire, where acquisitions broadened the company beyond its dependence on Adderall.

Vertex recruited Emmens to prepare a research-led biotechnology business for its first product launches. As chairman, president and chief executive, he hired managers and built a sales organisation before Incivek reached the market. He stepped aside after the company became profitable and integrated research with marketing, while Kalydeco was approaching regulatory review. He later served on the Bristol Myers Squibb board until 2021.
long_biography.html:
At Astra Merck, Matthew William Emmens helped build a stand-alone drug company around cross-functional teams, giving research, manufacturing and commercial staff a shared voice. The joint venture marketed Prilosec, then the world's bestselling medicine, and Emmens later became its chief executive. He carried that commercial focus to Shire, where acquisitions broadened the company beyond its dependence on Adderall.

Vertex recruited Emmens to prepare a research-led biotechnology business for its first product launches. As chairman, president and chief executive, he hired managers and built a sales organisation before Incivek reached the market. He stepped aside after the company became profitable and integrated research with marketing, while Kalydeco was approaching regulatory review. He later served on the Bristol Myers Squibb board until 2021.
